# alpha

A fixture record repo for record-index's own test suite. It carries two arcs, one of
which is split across two ruling documents whose rulings both number from one — which
is the collision the arc-versus-experiment split exists to avoid.

This repo's top-level prose file is OVERVIEW.md rather than README.md, and its
experiments table is INDEX.md rather than README.md, because both paths are DECLARED.
A tool that only found them under their conventional names would be reading a fact
about one repo as a fact about every repo.

## What is here

The experiments directory holds the ruling documents, one kickoff carrying two session
handoffs, a spec and a report. The law book is CLAUDE.md and it carries all three law
forms: bold-lead paragraphs, numbered role rules and bulleted constraints.

## The counts this document claims

E01 carries 3 rulings, which is wrong on purpose: this is a current-state document, so
the sweep must call the disagreement STALE rather than as-of-writing.

E02 carries 2 rulings so far, which is a true count wearing a modifier the sweep cannot
resolve, so it must be reported AMBIGUOUS rather than read as a number.

The record has 3 experiments, which is count-claim-shaped and belongs to no declared
family, so it must land in the unparseable list rather than being guessed at.

## What this repo is not

It is not a project and it does not build anything. Every artifact path it names is
invented so the artifact extractor has path-shaped tokens to find, and the mesh
outputs/e02/bridge.glb has never existed on any disk.
